document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your map does not really coincide with official cartography of 
the area. The authorities admit many gaps in their knowledge 
of the region, but the discrepancy is unsettling.

You  have  no  trouble  assembling  a  grubstake  and  a  party 
of  eager  partners.  The  season  is  getting  late,  however,  and 
the weeks you spend seeking your “lost ledge of gold” prove 
fruitless. When one prospector vanishes and another is found 
beheaded, your partners call off the hunt.

Delete the keywords RESONATE and CHARCOAL if you have 
them. Then, go to 529.
